name: Better Analyst (formerly Formula Bot)
summary: All-in-one analytics app, formerly Formula Bot, for enrichment, analysis, dashboards and automation.
description: Better Analyst is the new name for Formula Bot, with the same account and workflows. It connects to data sources, answers questions in plain language, enriches data, builds AI dashboards and automates recurring analysis, with exports to Excel and a Slack integration in beta.

howToUse.title: Open Better Analyst
howToUse.description: Go to Better Analyst, formerly Formula Bot, and choose Try free. The same account and workflows carry over.

howToUse.title: Connect sources and ask
howToUse.description: Connect data sources and ask questions in plain language. Better Analyst enriches the data and answers those questions.

howToUse.title: Dashboard, export, or Slack
howToUse.description: Build AI dashboards, automate recurring analysis, export to Excel, or try the Slack integration in beta.
